title: AutoEnergyDesign: An LLM-Driven Agent for Automatic Energy System Design Optimization
title_zh: AutoEnergyDesign：一个由大语言模型驱动的自动能源系统设计优化智能体

paragraphs.en: The design optimization of building energy systems represents a complex, high-dimensional search problem involving discrete technology selections, continuous sizing parameters, and intricate economic trade-offs. When each design must be evaluated by a year-long simulation, the mixed-integer nature of the problem and its non-convex cost surface make the search expensive for black-box optimizers, which typically require hundreds of evaluations. This paper presents AutoEnergyDesign , a framework that leverages Large Language Models (LLMs) as autonomous optimization agents for energy system configuration. The framework employs an iterative experimentation loop where an LLM agent reasons over previous simulation results, proposes configuration modifications and learns in context from the outcome of each simulation, while a git-based version control mechanism automatically reverts suboptimal changes. The agent couples a reasoning model with an explicit memory organisation (procedural instructions, semantic domain knowledge, episodic trial history with a per-experiment decision log, a reflective note, and the working context of the session), a constrained action interface, and an environment-grounded keep/revert feedback signal. We formulate the complete mathematical model encompassing eight distinct energy technologies (photovoltaic panels, micro-wind turbines, combined heat and power units, solar thermal collectors, gas boilers, battery storage, heat pumps, and inverters) with detailed Net Present Cost (NPC) calculations including capital expenditures, operational expenditures, and end-of-horizon salvage value over a 25-year horizon. The proposed methodology is evaluated on a case study based on measured building load profiles, against established baselines including random search, Tree-structured Parzen Estimator (TPE) Bayesian optimization, and a ( 1 + 1 ) (1+1) evolution strategy that shares the agent’s acceptance rule. The agent is instantiated with three Claude models of increasing capability (Haiku 5.5, Sonnet 5.5 and Opus 5.5), each run ten times with a budget of 50 simulations, and compared with random search, TPE and the ( 1 + 1 ) (1+1) evolution strategy, run for 300 evaluations over ten seeds. With all three models the agent reaches a Net Present Cost of about 3.53 MEUR, 1.20% below the best value found by TPE and 0.23% below the best value of the evolution strategy.
paragraphs.zh: 建筑能源系统的设计优化是一个复杂的高维搜索问题，涉及离散的技术选择、连续的容量参数以及复杂的经济性权衡。 当每个设计方案都必须通过长达一年的仿真来评估时，该问题的混合整数特性及其非凸的成本曲面使得搜索对黑盒优化器而言代价高昂，而黑盒优化器通常需要数百次评估。 本文提出 AutoEnergyDesign，一个利用大语言模型（LLM）作为自主优化智能体来进行能源系统配置的框架。 该框架采用迭代实验循环，其中 LLM 智能体对先前的仿真结果进行推理、提出配置修改并从每次仿真的结果中进行上下文学习，同时基于 git 的版本控制机制会自动回退次优更改。 该智能体将推理模型与显式的记忆组织（程序性指令、语义领域知识、带有每次实验决策日志的情景试验历史、反思笔记以及会话的工作上下文）、受约束的动作接口以及基于环境的保留/回退反馈信号相结合。 我们构建了涵盖八种不同能源技术（光伏板、微型风力涡轮机、热电联产机组、太阳能集热器、燃气锅炉、电池储能、热泵和逆变器）的完整数学模型，并进行详细的净现值（NPC）计算，包括资本支出、运营支出以及25年周期内的期末残值。 我们在基于实测建筑负荷曲线的案例研究上评估所提出的方法，并与既有基线进行比较，包括随机搜索、树结构帕森估计器（TPE）贝叶斯优化以及与该智能体共享接受规则的 (1+1) 进化策略。 该智能体分别使用三种能力递增的 Claude 模型（Haiku 5.5、Sonnet 5.5 和 Opus 5.5）实例化，每个模型运行十次、预算为50次仿真，并与随机搜索、TPE 和 (1+1) 进化策略进行比较，后者在十个随机种子上运行300次评估。 使用全部三种模型时，该智能体均达到约353万欧元的净现值，比 TPE 找到的最优值低1.20%，比进化策略的最优值低0.23%。

paragraphs.en: The agent comes within 1% of this design after a median of 18 (Opus) to 27.5 (Haiku) simulations, whereas among the baselines only the evolution strategy does so, in half of its seeds and after a median of 192 evaluations. paragraphs.en: Designing building energy systems is challenging because technology selection, capacity sizing, dispatch strategy, and lifecycle economics are tightly coupled. Capacity choices affect dispatch flexibility, while dispatch assumptions influence economically optimal sizes. The design is therefore optimized with respect to the Net Present Cost (NPC), which integrates capital expenditures (CAPEX), replacement costs, fixed and variable operating expenditures (OPEX), and energy purchase costs over the 25-year analysis horizon.
paragraphs.zh: 设计建筑能源系统颇具挑战性，因为技术选择、容量确定、调度策略与全生命周期经济性之间紧密耦合。 容量选择会影响调度灵活性，而调度假设又会影响经济上最优的容量规模。 因此，该设计以净现值成本（NPC）为目标进行优化，该指标在25年的分析期内综合考量了资本支出（CAPEX）、更换成本、固定与可变运营支出（OPEX）以及能源购买成本。

paragraphs.en: Conventional optimization methods (e.g., mixed-integer programming and evolutionary algorithms) remain valuable but face practical limits in simulation-driven settings with non-convex, multimodal landscapes and expensive black-box evaluations [ 16 , 22 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 传统优化方法（如混合整数规划和进化算法）仍然有价值，但在具有非凸、多峰地形和昂贵黑箱评估的仿真驱动场景中面临实际限制 [ 16 , 22 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) suggest an alternative: optimization through iterative reasoning, experimentation, and feedback. Inspired by autonomous experimentation paradigms such as AutoResearch [ 23 ] , LLM-driven optimization can incorporate domain knowledge, produce explicit, human-readable decision rationales, and adapt strategy over time. More generally, the object we build is an agent in the classical sense of an entity that perceives its environment through sensors and acts upon it through actuators [ 39 ] : in the LLM instantiation, a reasoning model is augmented with memory, an action interface, and a reflection mechanism, to obtain a goal-directed system [ 15 , 47 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）的最新进展提示了另一种方案：通过迭代推理、实验和反馈来进行优化。 受 AutoResearch [23] 等自主实验范式的启发，由 LLM 驱动的优化可以融入领域知识，产生明确、人类可读的决策依据，并随时间调整策略。 更一般地说，我们所构建的对象是经典意义上的智能体，即通过传感器感知环境并通过执行器作用于环境的实体 [39]：在 LLM 实例化中，一个推理模型被增强了记忆、动作接口和反思机制，从而构成一个目标导向的系统 [15, 47]。

paragraphs.en: This paper presents AutoEnergyDesign , an LLM-driven framework for building energy system optimization. Our main contributions are: (1) an optimization architecture that couples LLM reasoning with structured experimental feedback, organized around an explicit set of memories, (2) a techno-economic formulation covering eight energy technologies with detailed NPC modeling, (3) a git-based state-management mechanism that preserves best-known configurations while reverting suboptimal updates, and (4) an empirical comparison against random search, a ( 1 + 1 ) (1+1) evolution strategy with the same acceptance rule as the agent, and Bayesian optimization baselines, using three LLMs of different capability to show how the results depend on the model.
paragraphs.zh: 本文提出 AutoEnergyDesign，一个由大语言模型驱动的建筑能源系统优化框架。 我们的主要贡献包括：(1) 一种将大语言模型推理与结构化实验反馈相耦合的优化架构，围绕一组显式的记忆组织；(2) 一种涵盖八种能源技术并包含详细 NPC（净现值成本）建模的技术经济建模公式；(3) 一种基于 git 的状态管理机制，在回退次优更新的同时保留已知的最佳配置；(4) 一项与随机搜索、采用与智能体相同接受规则的 (1+1) 进化策略以及贝叶斯优化基线的实证比较，使用三个能力不同的大语言模型来展示结果对模型的依赖关系。

paragraphs.en: The optimization of building energy systems sits at the intersection of different active research areas: (i) classical methods for energy system design, (ii) emerging applications of Large Language Models (LLMs) in building energy domains, and (iii) LLM-driven optimization paradigms recently developed in the machine learning community. This section reviews each area, identifies key gaps, and positions our contribution within this landscape.
paragraphs.zh: 建筑能源系统的优化处于多个活跃研究领域的交叉点：(i) 经典的能源系统设计方法，(ii) 大语言模型（LLM）在建筑能源领域的新兴应用，以及 (iii) 机器学习界近期发展出的由大语言模型驱动的优化范式。 本节回顾各个领域，指出关键缺口，并在此背景下定位我们的贡献。

paragraphs.en: The design optimization of hybrid residential energy systems has evolved significantly over the past two decades. Early studies established that technology sizing and operational dispatch must be optimized jointly rather than sequentially, particularly for micro-combined heat and power (micro-CHP) and hybrid thermal-electric configurations [ 17 , 37 , 41 , 32 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 住宅混合能源系统的设计优化在过去二十年中取得了显著发展。 早期研究已经确立，技术容量配置与运行调度必须联合优化而非顺序优化，对于微型热电联产（micro-CHP）以及热电混合配置而言尤其如此 [ 17 , 37 , 41 , 32 ] 。

sents.en: The design optimization of hybrid residential energy systems has evolved significantly over the past two decades.
sents.zh: 住宅混合能源系统的设计优化在过去二十年中取得了显著发展。

paragraphs.en: From a methodological standpoint, three primary approaches dominate the literature:
paragraphs.zh: 从方法论角度来看，文献中主要有三种方法占据主导地位：

paragraphs.en: Mixed-Integer Programming (MIP). Linear and mixed-integer linear programming formulations provide exact solutions for convex approximations of the design problem [ 16 , 22 ] . However, the nonlinearities inherent in component performance curves, economies of scale in costing, and discrete technology choices often render MIP formulations computationally prohibitive for realistic problem instances with year-long simulation horizons.
paragraphs.zh: 混合整数规划（MIP）。 线性规划和混合整数线性规划的建模方法可为该设计问题的凸近似提供精确解 [ 16 , 22 ] 。 然而，部件性能曲线中固有的非线性、成本核算中的规模经济以及离散的技术选择，往往使得 MIP 模型在具有全年仿真时长的实际问题上计算上难以承受。

sents.en: Mixed-Integer Programming (MIP).
sents.zh: 混合整数规划（MIP）。

sents.en: Linear and mixed-integer linear programming formulations provide exact solutions for convex approximations of the design problem [ 16 , 22 ] .
sents.zh: 线性规划和混合整数线性规划的建模方法可为该设计问题的凸近似提供精确解 [ 16 , 22 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Metaheuristics. Evolutionary algorithms, particularly NSGA-II and its variants, remain widely adopted for building and microgrid optimization because they handle nonlinearity, constraints, and multiple objectives without requiring gradients [ 11 , 52 , 46 , 14 , 8 , 9 , 56 , 7 , 24 , 3 , 5 , 57 ] . These methods maintain a population of candidate solutions and evolve them through selection, crossover, and mutation operators. While effective for multimodal landscapes, they typically require extensive hyperparameter tuning and large evaluation budgets.
paragraphs.zh: 元启发式算法。 进化算法，特别是 NSGA-II 及其变体，仍被广泛用于建筑与微电网优化，因为它们无需梯度即可处理非线性、约束和多目标问题 [ 11 , 52 , 46 , 14 , 8 , 9 , 56 , 7 , 24 , 3 , 5 , 57 ] 。 这些方法维护一个由候选解组成的种群，并通过选择、交叉和变异算子对其进行演化。 虽然它们对多峰问题有效，但通常需要大量的超参数调优和巨大的评估预算。

sents.en: Metaheuristics.
sents.zh: 元启发式算法。

paragraphs.en: Bayesian Optimization. For expensive black-box objectives, Bayesian optimization offers superior sample efficiency by constructing a probabilistic surrogate model (typically a Gaussian Process) and optimizing an acquisition function to balance exploration and exploitation [ 43 ] . The Tree-structured Parzen Estimator (TPE) [ 4 , 2 , 48 ] extends this framework to mixed-variable spaces, while MOTPE enables multi-objective optimization [ 35 ] . TPE has become a standard baseline for hyperparameter optimization and engineering design tasks where evaluations are costly.
paragraphs.zh: 贝叶斯优化。 对于代价高昂的黑箱目标函数，贝叶斯优化通过构建概率代理模型（通常是高斯过程）并优化采集函数来平衡探索与利用，从而具有卓越的样本效率 [ 43 ] 。 树结构帕森估计器（TPE）[ 4 , 2 , 48 ] 将该框架扩展到混合变量空间，而 MOTPE 则支持多目标优化 [ 35 ] 。 在评估代价高昂的超参数优化与工程设计任务中，TPE 已成为一种标准基线方法。

paragraphs.en: Despite their successes, these classical methods face persistent limitations in practice: they offer limited traceability regarding why specific configurations are preferred; they struggle to incorporate qualitative domain knowledge without explicit mathematical formulation; and they typically handle infeasible designs through penalty functions or repair operators that must be tailored to each problem.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管取得了成功，这些经典方法在实践中仍面临持续的局限性：它们对于为何偏好特定配置缺乏可追溯性；在不进行显式数学表述的情况下，难以融入定性的领域知识；并且它们通常通过惩罚函数或修复算子来处理不可行的设计，而这些方法必须针对每个问题量身定制。

paragraphs.en: The application of LLMs to building energy systems has expanded rapidly in recent years [ 27 , 53 , 40 ] . Within this broader landscape, one recurring line of work uses LLMs to support the generation of building energy models from textual descriptions and other early-stage design inputs [ 19 , 54 , 29 ] . The main contribution of these studies is a reduction in modeling effort and setup time, rather than the solution of the design optimization problem itself.
paragraphs.zh: 近年来，大语言模型在建筑能源系统中的应用迅速扩展 [27, 53, 40]。 在这一更广泛的图景中，一条反复出现的研究路线是利用大语言模型，根据文本描述及其他早期设计输入来支持建筑能源模型的生成 [19, 54, 29]。 这些研究的主要贡献在于减少建模工作量和设置时间，而非解决设计优化问题本身。

An interesting insight is that the LLM performs best when it does not act as the optimizer itself, but drives an exact solver through a structured tool interface.
paragraphs.zh: 在运行应用方面，近期研究已探索了利用大语言模型辅助决策的方法，用于能源系统中的经济调度、家庭能源管理及相关控制任务 [ 33 , 12 , 21 ]。 一个有趣的发现是，当大语言模型不充当优化器本身，而是通过结构化工具接口驱动精确求解器时，其表现最佳。

paragraphs.en: A distinct but related research stream, originating in the machine learning community, has explored more general ways of using LLMs as optimizers. In these works, the model is not used merely to summarize or classify information, but to propose candidate solutions on the basis of a problem description and the history of previous evaluations. One influential example is OPRO, introduced by Yang et al. [ 50 ] , where the optimization process is framed as iterative improvement through prompting: the model receives prior solutions and their scores, and then generates revised candidates. Although the approach was developed for general optimization and prompt-design tasks rather than for engineering systems with physical constraints, it helped establish the idea that language models can participate directly in search.
paragraphs.zh: 一条源于机器学习社区、既独立又相关的研究方向，探索了更通用地将 LLM 用作优化器的方法。 在这些工作中，模型不仅被用来总结或分类信息，还被用于依据问题描述和历史评估记录提出候选解。 一个具有影响力的例子是 Yang 等人提出的 OPRO。 [ 50 ]，其中优化过程被表述为通过提示进行的迭代改进：模型接收先前的解及其得分，然后生成修改后的候选解。 尽管该方法是为通用优化和提示设计任务而非面向具有物理约束的工程系统开发的，但它帮助确立了语言模型可以直接参与搜索这一思想。

paragraphs.en: A second line of work has pushed this idea toward more autonomous experimentation. Karpathy’s AutoResearch [ 23 ] showed how an LLM agent can modify code, run experiments, interpret outcomes, and iterate while relying on rollback mechanisms to maintain stability. In a different but related direction, FunSearch [ 38 ] combined language models with evolutionary search to generate and evaluate program variants, showing that LLMs can contribute within a systematic propose-and-test loop. The same idea has been employed in LLM-driven algorithm design , in which the model evolves the heuristic rather than the solution. In EoH [ 25 ] , natural-language “thoughts” are coupled with the corresponding code in an evolutionary loop. ReEvo [ 51 ] adds an explicit reflection step that verbalises why one heuristic outperformed another before generating the next variant. LLaMEA [ 45 ] generates and refines entire metaheuristics from benchmark feedback. These developments are surveyed comprehensively in [ 26 ] . Taken together, these contributions suggest that LLMs may be useful not only as interfaces to technical systems, but also as components of the optimization process itself. At the same time, most of this literature has developed around prompt optimization, program synthesis, or machine learning workflows, and only rarely around engineering design problems with explicit techno-economic constraints. It is precisely this gap that motivates the present work.
paragraphs.zh: 第二类工作将这一思路推向更自主的实验。 Karpathy 的 AutoResearch [23] 展示了大语言模型智能体如何修改代码、运行实验、解读结果并进行迭代，同时依靠回滚机制来保持稳定性。 在另一个不同但相关的方向上，FunSearch [38] 将语言模型与进化搜索相结合，以生成并评估程序变体，表明大语言模型可以在系统化的“提出—测试”循环中发挥作用。 同样的思路也被应用于大语言模型驱动的算法设计中，此时模型演化的是启发式方法而非解本身。 在 EoH [25] 中，自然语言的“想法”与相应的代码在进化循环中耦合在一起。 ReEvo [51] 增加了一个显式的反思步骤，在生成下一个变体之前，先用语言说明为什么某个启发式方法优于另一个。 LLaMEA [45] 根据基准测试的反馈生成并改进完整的元启发式算法。 这些进展在 [26] 中得到了全面的综述。 综合来看，这些工作表明，大语言模型不仅可能作为技术系统的接口发挥作用，还可能作为优化过程本身的组成部分发挥作用。 与此同时，这类文献大多围绕提示词优化、程序合成或机器学习工作流展开，很少围绕具有明确技术经济约束的工程设计问题展开。 正是这一空白激发了本研究。

sents.zh: 在另一个不同但相关的方向上，FunSearch [38] 将语言模型与进化搜索相结合，以生成并评估程序变体，表明大语言模型可以在系统化的“提出—测试”循环中发挥作用。

sents.en: The same idea has been employed in LLM-driven algorithm design , in which the model evolves the heuristic rather than the solution.
sents.zh: 同样的思路也被应用于大语言模型驱动的算法设计中，此时模型演化的是启发式方法而非解本身。

sents.en: In EoH [ 25 ] , natural-language “thoughts” are coupled with the corresponding code in an evolutionary loop.
sents.zh: 在 EoH [25] 中，自然语言的“想法”与相应的代码在进化循环中耦合在一起。

sents.en: ReEvo [ 51 ] adds an explicit reflection step that verbalises why one heuristic outperformed another before generating the next variant.
sents.zh: ReEvo [51] 增加了一个显式的反思步骤，在生成下一个变体之前，先用语言说明为什么某个启发式方法优于另一个。

sents.en: LLaMEA [ 45 ] generates and refines entire metaheuristics from benchmark feedback.
sents.zh: LLaMEA [45] 根据基准测试的反馈生成并改进完整的元启发式算法。

sents.en: These developments are surveyed comprehensively in [ 26 ] .
sents.zh: 这些进展在 [26] 中得到了全面的综述。

sents.en: Taken together, these contributions suggest that LLMs may be useful not only as interfaces to technical systems, but also as components of the optimization process itself.
sents.zh: 综合来看，这些工作表明，大语言模型不仅可能作为技术系统的接口发挥作用，还可能作为优化过程本身的组成部分发挥作用。

sents.en: At the same time, most of this literature has developed around prompt optimization, program synthesis, or machine learning workflows, and only rarely around engineering design problems with explicit techno-economic constraints.
sents.zh: 与此同时，这类文献大多围绕提示词优化、程序合成或机器学习工作流展开，很少围绕具有明确技术经济约束的工程设计问题展开。

sents.en: It is precisely this gap that motivates the present work.
sents.zh: 正是这一空白激发了本研究。

paragraphs.en: A recent survey of LLMs as optimizers [ 36 ] organises this space into three paradigms: direct optimization, in which the model itself generates and refines candidate solutions; tool-augmented optimization, in which the model formalises the problem and delegates it to an exact solver; and tool-creating optimization, in which the model synthesises reusable heuristics. AutoEnergyDesign can be considered as belonging to the first paradigm.
paragraphs.zh: 最近一项关于将大语言模型用作优化器的综述 [ 36 ] 将这一领域划分为三种范式：直接优化，即模型自身生成并改进候选解；工具增强优化，即模型将问题形式化并委托给精确求解器；以及工具创造优化，即模型合成可复用的启发式方法。 AutoEnergyDesign 可以被视为属于第一种范式。

paragraphs.en: Beyond these foundational works, several recent contributions use LLMs as optimization engines in ways that are directly comparable to ours.
paragraphs.zh: 除了这些奠基性工作之外，近期还有一些研究以与我们直接可比的方式，将大语言模型用作优化引擎。

paragraphs.en: Liu et al. [ 28 ] proposed LLAMBO, which frames Bayesian optimization (BO) in natural language and uses an LLM to enhance individual BO components without any fine-tuning. LLAMBO is validated on hyperparameter tuning.
paragraphs.zh: Liu 等人 [28] 提出了 LLAMBO，该框架将贝叶斯优化（BO）用自然语言表述，并利用大语言模型（LLM）来增强各个 BO 组件，且无需任何微调。 LLAMBO 在超参数调优任务上得到了验证。

sents.en: Liu et al.
sents.zh: Liu 等人

sents.en: [ 28 ] proposed LLAMBO, which frames Bayesian optimization (BO) in natural language and uses an LLM to enhance individual BO components without any fine-tuning.

paragraphs.en: AhmadiTeshnizi et al. [ 1 ] introduced OptiMUS, an LLM agent that formulates and solves mixed-integer linear programs from natural-language descriptions by writing the mathematical model, generating and debugging solver code, and validating solutions. OptiMUS lowers the barrier to operations-research modeling but delegates the actual optimization to an exact solver. In contrast, AutoEnergyDesign keeps the techno-economic model fixed and uses the LLM as the search mechanism over a non-convex, simulation-based black box. The LLM proposes configurations , not problem formulations, and an exact solver is used only for the inner hourly dispatch, not for the design-space search.
paragraphs.zh: AhmadiTeshnizi 等人 [ 1 ] 提出了 OptiMUS，这是一个 LLM 智能体，能够根据自然语言描述建立并求解混合整数线性规划：它编写数学模型、生成并调试求解器代码，并对解进行验证。 OptiMUS 降低了运筹学建模的门槛，但将实际的优化工作交给了精确求解器。 相比之下，AutoEnergyDesign 保持技术经济模型固定，并将 LLM 用作在基于仿真的非凸黑箱上进行搜索的机制。 LLM 提出的是配置，而非问题表述；精确求解器仅用于内部的逐小时调度，而非设计空间的搜索。

sents.en: AhmadiTeshnizi et al.
sents.zh: AhmadiTeshnizi 等人

paragraphs.en: AlphaEvolve [ 34 ] orchestrates an ensemble of LLMs in a population-based evolutionary loop that edits and evolves entire codebases, achieving state-of-the-art results on algorithm discovery and infrastructure optimization tasks under substantial compute. Our framework targets a different regime: a single agent operating under a tight evaluation budget, a sequential keep/revert trajectory rather than a large evolutionary population, and a fixed engineering artifact (a building energy system) rather than open-ended algorithm discovery. The emphasis here is on auditable reasoning traces and explicit injection of techno-economic domain knowledge, rather than on large-scale evolutionary search.
paragraphs.zh: AlphaEvolve [ 34 ] 在基于种群的进化循环中协调一组大语言模型，对整个代码库进行编辑和演化，在大量算力支持下于算法发现和基础设施优化任务上取得了最先进的成果。 我们的框架针对的是不同的场景：在严格的评估预算下运行的单个智能体、顺序式的保留/回退轨迹而非大型进化种群，以及固定的工程产物（建筑能源系统）而非开放式的算法发现。 这里的重点在于可审计的推理轨迹以及技术经济领域知识的显式注入，而非大规模进化搜索。

paragraphs.en: Eureka [ 30 ] uses a coding LLM to evolve reward functions for reinforcement learning, with environment code as context and a reward-reflection step, evaluating each candidate through full RL training runs. The LLM output is the code that defines the objective, which is then optimized downstream by RL. AutoEnergyDesign instead optimizes the decision variables directly against a fixed, externally defined economic objective evaluated by a deterministic physics-and-economics simulator; there is no RL stage and no reward-code synthesis.
paragraphs.zh: Eureka[30]使用编码大语言模型来演化强化学习的奖励函数，以环境代码作为上下文并包含奖励反思步骤，通过完整的强化学习训练运行来评估每个候选奖励函数。 大语言模型的输出是定义目标的代码，随后由强化学习在下游对该目标进行优化。 AutoEnergyDesign 则直接针对一个固定的、外部定义的经济目标进行决策变量优化，该目标由确定性的物理与经济学仿真器评估；整个流程中没有强化学习阶段，也没有奖励代码的合成。

paragraphs.en: Taken together, these works show that LLMs can act as warm-starters or sub-components of BO (LLAMBO), as formulators that hand the problem to an exact solver (OptiMUS), as large-scale evolutionary code optimizers (AlphaEvolve, EoH, ReEvo, LLaMEA), or as designers of objectives for downstream learning (Eureka). AutoEnergyDesign occupies a complementary point in this space: a single, budget-constrained, auditable agent that performs the search directly over a constrained techno-economic design space, with persistent memory and git-based rollback as its state-management mechanism.
paragraphs.zh: 综合来看，这些工作表明大语言模型可以充当贝叶斯优化的热启动器或子组件（LLAMBO）、把问题交给精确求解器的建模者（OptiMUS）、大规模的演化式代码优化器（AlphaEvolve、EoH、ReEvo、LLaMEA），或为下游学习设计目标函数的设计者（Eureka）。 AutoEnergyDesign 在这一领域中占据一个互补的位置：它是一个单一的、受预算约束的、可审计的智能体，直接在一个受约束的技术经济设计空间中进行搜索，并以持久化记忆和基于 git 的回滚作为其状态管理机制。

paragraphs.en: From this literature review, we identify several key gaps that motivate our work:
paragraphs.zh: 通过这一文献综述，我们识别出若干关键的研究空白，这些空白促成了我们的工作：

paragraphs.en: Gap 1: Traceability of optimization decisions. Classical black-box optimizers (Bayesian, evolutionary) return solutions with minimal explanation. Practitioners cannot easily understand why a particular configuration is preferred. LLM-driven methods offer natural language reasoning traces, but these have not been systematically exploited in engineering optimization.
paragraphs.zh: 缺口1：优化决策的可追溯性。 经典的黑盒优化器（贝叶斯、进化）仅以极少的解释返回解决方案。 从业者难以理解为何偏好某个特定配置。 基于大语言模型驱动的方法提供了自然语言推理轨迹，但这些轨迹尚未在工程优化中得到系统性利用。

sents.en: Gap 1: Traceability of optimization decisions.
sents.zh: 缺口1：优化决策的可追溯性。

sents.en: Classical black-box optimizers (Bayesian, evolutionary) return solutions with minimal explanation.
sents.zh: 经典的黑盒优化器（贝叶斯、进化）仅以极少的解释返回解决方案。

sents.en: Practitioners cannot easily understand why a particular configuration is preferred.
sents.zh: 从业者难以理解为何偏好某个特定配置。

sents.en: LLM-driven methods offer natural language reasoning traces, but these have not been systematically exploited in engineering optimization.
sents.zh: 基于大语言模型驱动的方法提供了自然语言推理轨迹，但这些轨迹尚未在工程优化中得到系统性利用。

paragraphs.en: Gap 2: Integration of qualitative domain knowledge. Engineering design relies heavily on heuristics, physical intuition, and economic insights that are difficult to encode mathematically. Existing optimizers require explicit formulation of such knowledge as constraints or penalty functions. LLMs can absorb qualitative knowledge through prompting, but frameworks for systematic integration with simulation-based optimization are lacking.
paragraphs.zh: 缺口 2：定性领域知识的整合。 工程设计严重依赖启发式经验、物理直觉和经济洞察，这些难以用数学方式编码。 现有优化器要求将此类知识显式地表述为约束或惩罚函数。 大语言模型可以通过提示词吸收定性知识，但缺乏与基于仿真的优化进行系统性整合的框架。

sents.en: Gap 2: Integration of qualitative domain knowledge.
sents.zh: 缺口 2：定性领域知识的整合。

sents.en: Engineering design relies heavily on heuristics, physical intuition, and economic insights that are difficult to encode mathematically.
sents.zh: 工程设计严重依赖启发式经验、物理直觉和经济洞察，这些难以用数学方式编码。

sents.en: Existing optimizers require explicit formulation of such knowledge as constraints or penalty functions.
sents.zh: 现有优化器要求将此类知识显式地表述为约束或惩罚函数。

sents.en: LLMs can absorb qualitative knowledge through prompting, but frameworks for systematic integration with simulation-based optimization are lacking.
sents.zh: 大语言模型可以通过提示词吸收定性知识，但缺乏与基于仿真的优化进行系统性整合的框架。

paragraphs.en: Gap 3: Accessibility for practitioners. Advanced optimization tools require expertise in mathematical programming, algorithm configuration, or machine learning. There is a need for optimization workflows that are accessible to energy engineers without requiring deep optimization expertise.
paragraphs.zh: 差距三：面向从业者的可及性。 先进的优化工具需要具备数学规划、算法配置或机器学习方面的专业知识。 有必要构建让能源工程师无需深入优化专业知识也能使用的优化工作流。

sents.en: Gap 3: Accessibility for practitioners.
sents.zh: 差距三：面向从业者的可及性。

sents.en: Advanced optimization tools require expertise in mathematical programming, algorithm configuration, or machine learning.
sents.zh: 先进的优化工具需要具备数学规划、算法配置或机器学习方面的专业知识。

sents.en: There is a need for optimization workflows that are accessible to energy engineers without requiring deep optimization expertise.
sents.zh: 有必要构建让能源工程师无需深入优化专业知识也能使用的优化工作流。

paragraphs.en: AutoEnergyDesign addresses these gaps through the following features of the framework, which correspond to contributions (1) and (3) of Section 2 :
paragraphs.zh: AutoEnergyDesign 通过该框架的以下特性来弥补这些空白，这些特性对应第 2 节的贡献 (1) 和 (3)：

paragraphs.en: Traceable and auditable optimization. Our framework generates persistent reasoning traces (agent notes, and a decision log in which every experiment is justified before it is run and checked against its outcome afterwards) that record the rationale for design decisions, enabling practitioners to audit, validate and understand optimization trajectories, and to check each rationale against the outcome logged by the environment. In this way, the natural language interface and automated reasoning reduce the barrier to applying advanced optimization to energy system design.
paragraphs.zh: 可追溯、可审计的优化。 我们的框架生成持久化的推理轨迹（智能体笔记，以及一份决策日志——其中每个实验在运行前都会给出理由，并在运行后根据其结果进行核对），记录设计决策的依据，使从业者能够审计、验证和理解优化轨迹，并将每条依据与环境记录的结果进行核对。 通过这种方式，自然语言界面与自动化推理降低了将先进优化方法应用于能源系统设计的门槛。

sents.en: Traceable and auditable optimization.
sents.zh: 可追溯、可审计的优化。

sents.en: Our framework generates persistent reasoning traces (agent notes, and a decision log in which every experiment is justified before it is run and checked against its outcome afterwards) that record the rationale for design decisions, enabling practitioners to audit, validate and understand optimization trajectories, and to check each rationale against the outcome logged by the environment.
sents.zh: 我们的框架生成持久化的推理轨迹（智能体笔记，以及一份决策日志——其中每个实验在运行前都会给出理由，并在运行后根据其结果进行核对），记录设计决策的依据，使从业者能够审计、验证和理解优化轨迹，并将每条依据与环境记录的结果进行核对。

sents.en: In this way, the natural language interface and automated reasoning reduce the barrier to applying advanced optimization to energy system design.
sents.zh: 通过这种方式，自然语言界面与自动化推理降低了将先进优化方法应用于能源系统设计的门槛。

paragraphs.en: Structured domain knowledge integration. We separate operational instructions from domain knowledge (via the insights.md mechanism), allowing engineers to inject qualitative heuristics without modifying code or mathematical formulations. This is a deliberate separation of procedural memory (how to conduct the search) from semantic memory (what is true about the techno-economic context), which can be edited independently and audited by a domain expert [ 44 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 结构化领域知识集成。 我们将操作性指令与领域知识分离（通过 insights.md 机制），使工程师能够在不修改代码或数学公式的情况下注入定性启发式规则。 这是对程序性记忆（如何执行搜索）与语义记忆（技术经济背景中什么是真实的）的有意分离，二者可独立编辑，并由领域专家进行审计 [ 44 ]。

sents.en: Structured domain knowledge integration.
sents.zh: 结构化领域知识集成。

sents.en: We separate operational instructions from domain knowledge (via the insights.md mechanism), allowing engineers to inject qualitative heuristics without modifying code or mathematical formulations.
sents.zh: 我们将操作性指令与领域知识分离（通过 insights.md 机制），使工程师能够在不修改代码或数学公式的情况下注入定性启发式规则。

sents.en: This is a deliberate separation of procedural memory (how to conduct the search) from semantic memory (what is true about the techno-economic context), which can be edited independently and audited by a domain expert [ 44 ] .
sents.zh: 这是对程序性记忆（如何执行搜索）与语义记忆（技术经济背景中什么是真实的）的有意分离，二者可独立编辑，并由领域专家进行审计 [ 44 ]。

paragraphs.en: Git-based safe exploration. Our commit/revert mechanism ensures that the system never loses a known-good configuration, enabling aggressive exploration without risk of catastrophic performance degradation. This extends the version control concept from AutoResearch to simulation-driven engineering optimization.

paragraphs.en: Relative to general LLM-driven optimizers like OPRO, we provide domain-specific structure (simulator integration, techno-economic constraints) and an explicit state-management layer, combining the git-based rollback of AutoResearch with episodic and reflective memories (Table 2 ), a layer that is enforced by the environment rather than left to the model.
paragraphs.zh: 与 OPRO 等通用 LLM 驱动的优化器相比，我们提供了领域特定的结构（仿真器集成、技术经济约束）以及一个显式的状态管理层，将 AutoResearch 基于Git的回滚与情景记忆和反思记忆相结合（表2），该层由环境强制执行，而非交由模型自行决定。

paragraphs.en: To the best of our knowledge, and consistently with the most recent surveys of LLMs in building energy and power system applications [ 27 , 53 , 40 ] , the LLM-as-optimizer paradigm has so far been applied in this domain to operation and dispatch [ 33 , 12 , 21 ] or to model formulation [ 20 , 19 ] , but not to design-phase technology selection and sizing against a full lifecycle cost model. The present work is, in this specific sense, the first to do so with a techno-economic model spanning eight technologies and a 25-year NPC horizon.
paragraphs.zh: 据我们所知，并与关于大语言模型在建筑能耗与电力系统应用中的最新综述[27, 53, 40]相一致，「LLM 作为优化器」这一范式迄今在该领域的应用仅限于运行与调度[33, 12, 21]或模型构建[20, 19]，尚未针对完整生命周期成本模型用于设计阶段的技术选择与容量配置。 就这一特定意义而言，本研究是首个采用覆盖八种技术、25 年净现值成本（NPC）周期的技术经济模型开展此类工作的研究。

paragraphs.en: The purpose of this study is not to replace exact optimization methods when a suitable mathematical formulation is available. If both equipment sizing and operational dispatch can be represented by linear relationships and integer decisions, they can be optimized jointly using mixed-integer linear programming (MILP). In that setting, an exact solver can provide optimality guarantees that the proposed LLM agent does not offer.
paragraphs.zh: 本研究的目的不是在存在合适数学建模的情况下取代精确优化方法。 如果设备选型与运行调度都可以用线性关系和整数决策来表示，则可以使用混合整数线性规划（MILP）对它们进行联合优化。 在这种情况下，精确求解器可以提供所提出的LLM智能体无法提供的最优性保证。

paragraphs.en: Our framework instead targets simulation-based design problems that are difficult to express in this form, for example because they involve nonlinear component models, tabulated performance data, economies of scale, or an existing simulator whose internal formulation cannot be modified. In these settings, the agent proposes designs and learns from their simulated performance without requiring an explicit mathematical formulation of the entire design problem. The present case study uses linear-programming dispatch to provide a transparent and well-defined evaluation environment. It therefore demonstrates the agent’s search behavior in a controlled setting, rather than establishing that exact optimization is infeasible for this instance or that the agent is superior to an exact solver.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的框架则针对的是难以用这种形式表达的基于仿真的设计问题，例如因为它们涉及非线性组件模型、表格化性能数据、规模经济，或内部表述无法修改的现有仿真器。 在这些情形下，智能体提出设计并从其仿真性能中学习，而无需整个设计问题的显式数学表述。 本案例研究使用线性规划调度来提供一个透明且定义明确的评估环境。 因此，它展示的是智能体在受控环境中的搜索行为，而非证明精确优化对该实例不可行，或智能体优于精确求解器。

paragraphs.en: The following sections detail our methodology, experimental validation against TPE, ( 1 + 1 ) (1+1) evolution strategy and random search baselines, and discussion of implications for energy system design practice.

paragraphs.en: This section presents the methodology underlying the AutoEnergyDesign framework. We begin by describing the LLM-driven agent architecture, including the instruction file, feedback mechanisms, and version control integration, and then we describe the mathematical formulation of the energy system simulator, including detailed models for each technology, the Net Present Cost calculation methodology, and the optimal dispatch formulation.

paragraphs.en: The agent implements an iterative experimentation loop inspired by Karpathy’s AutoResearch [ 23 ] : a language model repeatedly edits a configuration file, runs the simulator, and decides the next change on the basis of the results obtained so far. The model is not called through an API by a custom runner but operates inside a general-purpose coding agent, Claude Code, which gives it a file reader, a file editor and a shell. Everything else (the simulator, the validator, the acceptance rule and the logs) consists of ordinary scripts and files. The files and components involved are shown schematically in Figure 1 .
paragraphs.zh: 该智能体实现了一个受 Karpathy 的 AutoResearch [23] 启发的迭代实验循环：一个语言模型反复编辑配置文件、运行模拟器，并根据迄今获得的结果决定下一步的改动。 该模型不是通过 API 由自定义运行器调用，而是在通用编码智能体 Claude Code 内部运行，Claude Code 为其提供了文件读取器、文件编辑器和 shell。 其余部分（模拟器、验证器、接受规则和日志）均由普通脚本和文件构成。 所涉及的文件和组件在图 1 中示意性地展示。

paragraphs.en: The reflective note follows a fixed template with four headings: Worked (changes that reduced the NPC, with direction and amount), Failed (changes that were worse, infeasible or out of range), Behavior (sensitive technologies, interactions, exhausted regions) and Next (two or three experiments to try). It condenses the trajectory into verbal lessons, in the spirit of Reflexion [ 42 ] , and its Next section is the starting point for the following decisions. The decision log complements it at the level of single steps: since each expectation is written before the result is known, every prediction can be checked afterwards against the outcome, and the log is the main source for the qualitative analysis of Section 7.5 .
paragraphs.zh: 反思笔记遵循固定模板，包含四个标题：有效（降低了 NPC 的改动，附方向与幅度）、失败（效果更差、不可行或超出范围的改动）、行为（敏感技术、交互作用、已穷尽的区域）以及下一步（两到三个待尝试的实验）。 它以 Reflexion [ 42 ] 的精神，将轨迹浓缩为语言化的经验教训，其「下一步」部分是后续决策的起点。 决策日志在单步层面与其互补：由于每条期望都在结果未知之前写下，因此每个预测事后都可以与实际结果进行核对，且该日志是第 7.5 节定性分析的主要来源。

sents.en: The reflective note follows a fixed template with four headings: Worked (changes that reduced the NPC, with direction and amount), Failed (changes that were worse, infeasible or out of range), Behavior (sensitive technologies, interactions, exhausted regions) and Next (two or three experiments to try).
sents.zh: 反思笔记遵循固定模板，包含四个标题：有效（降低了 NPC 的改动，附方向与幅度）、失败（效果更差、不可行或超出范围的改动）、行为（敏感技术、交互作用、已穷尽的区域）以及下一步（两到三个待尝试的实验）。

sents.en: It condenses the trajectory into verbal lessons, in the spirit of Reflexion [ 42 ] , and its Next section is the starting point for the following decisions.

sents.en: The decision log complements it at the level of single steps: since each expectation is written before the result is known, every prediction can be checked afterwards against the outcome, and the log is the main source for the qualitative analysis of Section 7.5 .

paragraphs.en: The instruction file CLAUDE.md contains the per-experiment procedure above and the following rules:
paragraphs.zh: 指令文件 CLAUDE.md 包含上述每次实验的操作流程以及以下规则：

paragraphs.en: minimize the NPC reported by the simulator;
paragraphs.zh: 最小化模拟器报告的 NPC；

paragraphs.en: edit only config.py , agent_notes.md and decisions.md , and do not read or modify the simulator, the cost parameters or the hooks;
paragraphs.zh: 只编辑 config.py、agent_notes.md 和 decisions.md，不要读取或修改模拟器、成本参数或钩子（hooks）；

paragraphs.en: respect the range and step of each variable, keep at least one thermal source (boiler, heat pump or CHP) enabled, and leave the inverter activation lines unchanged;
paragraphs.zh: 尊重每个变量的取值范围和步长，至少保留一个热源（锅炉、热泵或热电联产机组）处于启用状态，并保持逆变器的启用行不变；

paragraphs.en: change one to three logically related parameters per experiment, and in the first experiments switch technologies on and off before fine-tuning sizes;
paragraphs.zh: 每次实验改变一到三个逻辑相关的参数，并且在最初的实验中先开关各技术，然后再微调尺寸；

paragraphs.en: after a rejected experiment, do not retry the same values;
paragraphs.zh: 在一次被拒绝的实验之后，不要重试相同的值；

paragraphs.en: never ask questions and never stop before the budget is exhausted.
paragraphs.zh: 永远不要提问，并且在预算耗尽之前绝不停止。

paragraphs.en: The domain-knowledge file insights.md contains only input data, copied from the cost parameters of the simulator: energy prices (electricity purchase 0.30 EUR/kWh, export 0.08 EUR/kWh, natural gas 0.12 EUR/kWh); for each technology, its efficiency or performance data, specific CAPEX and OPEX and lifetime; the time-shared operation of the reversible heat pump, stated as a rule (heating share plus cooling share at most 100% of its size in each hour); the fact that inverter costs are included in those of PV, wind and battery; the absence of thermal storage; the replacement and salvage rules; and the absence of active self-sufficiency or CO 2 constraints. It contains no rankings of technologies and no design guidance. Since the agent is told not to read the simulator or its parameters, this file is its only source of information on the scenario besides the simulator output.
paragraphs.zh: 领域知识文件 insights.md 仅包含输入数据，均复制自模拟器的成本参数：能源价格（购电 0.30 欧元/千瓦时，上网售电 0.08 欧元/千瓦时，天然气 0.12 欧元/千瓦时）；每项技术的效率或性能数据、单位 CAPEX 与 OPEX 以及使用寿命；可逆热泵的分时运行规则，以规则形式表述（每小时制热份额加制冷份额至多为其容量的 100%）；逆变器成本已包含在光伏、风电和电池成本中这一事实；无储热装置；更换与残值规则；以及不存在主动自给自足或 CO₂ 约束。 该文件不包含任何技术排名或设计指导。 由于智能体被要求不得读取模拟器及其参数，除模拟器输出外，该文件是其了解场景的唯一信息来源。

paragraphs.en: The rule is implemented with git. Each run works on a dedicated branch, exp/<timestamp> . After every simulation the post-execution hook commits config.py ; if the design is kept, it records the new best NPC, and otherwise it restores the previous config.py and commits the revert. Every trial, kept or discarded, is appended to results.tsv with its full parameter vector, feasibility flag and outcome, and search_history.md and .last_status are regenerated from it. paragraphs.en: The energy system design optimization problem can be stated as follows. Given a set of available technologies 𝒯 \mathcal{T} , hourly electricity, heat and cooling demands over a planning horizon t = 1 , … , T t=1,\dots,T , and economic parameters such as energy prices and discount rate, the objective is to identify the design vector 𝐱 \mathbf{x} (technology activation and sizing) and the operational dispatch 𝐮 1 : T \mathbf{u}_{1:T} that minimize lifecycle Net Present Cost while meeting demand at each time step. Demand that the system cannot meet is represented explicitly as unserved energy, which is penalised in the NPC.
paragraphs.zh: 能源系统设计优化问题可表述如下。 给定一组可用技术 𝒯 \mathcal{T} 、规划期内逐小时的电力、供热与制冷需求 t = 1 , … , T t=1,\dots,T ，以及能源价格和贴现率等经济参数，目标是确定设计向量 𝐱 \mathbf{x} （技术的启用与容量配置）和运行调度 𝐮 1 : T \mathbf{u}_{1:T} ，在满足每个时间步需求的同时最小化生命周期净现值成本。 系统无法满足的需求被显式表示为未满足能源，并在净现值成本中予以惩罚。

paragraphs.en: The measured series is an electrical load that includes the electricity used for space heating, space cooling and domestic hot water, in addition to the pure electrical uses. Since these end uses are not metered separately, the split is estimated. Each thermal-related share is given an hourly shape (heating and cooling degree-hours, with base temperatures of 20 and 22 ∘ C, during weekday office hours; a flat profile over weekday occupancy for DHW) and scaled to an assumed fraction of the annual load. In every hour the three shares are then capped so as to leave at least a daily baseline of pure electrical use, estimated from the night-time load. Since the two base temperatures do not overlap, space heating and cooling never occur in the same hour, whereas DHW can coincide with cooling.
paragraphs.zh: 所测得的序列是一个电力负荷，除了纯电力用途外，还包括空间供暖、空间制冷和生活热水所用的电力。 由于这些终端用途没有单独计量，因此对其占比进行了估算。 每个与热相关的份额都被赋予一个逐时曲线（工作日办公时间内基于 20 °C 和 22 °C 基准温度的供暖度和制冷度小时数；生活热水则采用工作日占用期间的平坦曲线），并按假定的年负荷比例进行缩放。 在每个小时内，对这三个份额进行上限约束，以便至少留下一个纯电力使用的每日基线，该基线根据夜间负荷估算得出。 由于两个基准温度不重叠，空间供暖和制冷从不在同一小时内出现，而生活热水则可能与制冷同时发生。

paragraphs.en: This section describes the experimental protocol used to evaluate the proposed LLM-driven optimization framework and to compare it against established black-box baselines.
paragraphs.zh: 本节介绍用于评估所提出的由大语言模型（LLM）驱动的优化框架，并将其与成熟的黑盒基线方法进行比较的实验方案。

paragraphs.en: All methods are evaluated under a common protocol to ensure that differences in performance reflect the search strategy rather than the surrounding infrastructure. In particular, all approaches share the same simulation environment, objective definition, and feasibility handling. The agent is run for a maximum of B = 50 B=50 experiments, with ten independent runs per model, whereas each baseline is run for 300 300 evaluations per seed over ten seeds. The agent is driven by the Claude Code coding agent (version 2.1.296) with three Claude models of increasing capability: Haiku 5.5, Sonnet 5.5 and Opus 5.5, all with the reasoning effort set to medium . All runs start from the same initial config.py , in which only a heat pump of 500 kW is installed, use the same instruction and domain-knowledge files, and differ only in the model and in the non-determinism of its sampling. Before the agent is started, the launch script simulates this default configuration and records it as experiment 1; the design is infeasible (it leaves part of the heating and cooling demand unserved, and its penalised NPC is about 977 MEUR), and the agent then chooses experiments 2 to 51. The baseline evaluation is not counted in the budget of 50 and is excluded from the statistics. To measure the contribution of the domain-knowledge file, ten further Opus 5.5 runs and ten further Haiku 5.5 runs are performed without access to insights.md : the file remains in the project directory, but is dropped from the list of files the agent reads at every experiment and added to the files the agent must not read, and the decision template no longer mentions it; everything else is unchanged (Section 7.4 ). Each run is stopped when the experiment counter reaches the budget or when the session ends. Twenty-nine of the thirty sessions used the whole budget; one Haiku 5.5 session ended after 36 experiments (35 chosen by the agent). All twenty ablation sessions used the whole budget. For every run we record the best feasible NPC found so far after each evaluation. Each method is then described by the best and the median of the final values over its runs, considering only the feasible solutions, and by the number of runs whose final design is the best one found in the study, whose NPC we denote by NPC ⋆ \mathrm{NPC}^{\star} .

paragraphs.en: To assess the quality of the proposed approach, we compare it against three baselines that represent complementary forms of black-box search: unguided random exploration, surrogate-guided Bayesian optimization, and a local search that uses the same acceptance rule as the agent.
paragraphs.zh: 为评估所提方法的质量，我们将其与三种基线方法进行比较，这些基线代表了互补的黑盒搜索形式：无引导的随机探索、代理模型引导的贝叶斯优化，以及使用与智能体相同接受规则的局部搜索。

paragraphs.en: Random search serves as the simplest reference method, drawing configurations uniformly from the admissible design space without using information from previous evaluations. In the present setting, boolean activation variables are sampled uniformly over their two possible states, while continuous parameters are sampled uniformly on the quantization grid of their admissible ranges (Optuna RandomSampler , with the same parametrisation used for TPE). Unlike the agent, random search and TPE are not filtered by the pre-execution validator: designs without a thermal source are simulated, found infeasible, and counted as evaluations. Although conceptually simple, random search remains a meaningful benchmark in high-dimensional optimization because it can explore broad regions of the space without the structural biases introduced by more elaborate methods.
paragraphs.zh: 随机搜索是最简单的参照方法，它从可接受的设计空间中均匀抽取配置，而不利用先前评估的信息。 在本设定中，布尔激活变量在其两个可能状态之间均匀采样，而连续参数则在其可接受范围的量化网格上均匀采样（Optuna RandomSampler，参数化方式与 TPE 相同）。 与智能体不同，随机搜索和 TPE 不受预执行验证器的过滤：没有热源的设计也会被仿真、被判定不可行，并计为一次评估。 尽管概念上简单，随机搜索在高维优化中仍然是一个有意义的基准，因为它可以在不引入更复杂方法所带有的结构性偏差的情况下探索空间的广大区域。

paragraphs.en: As a stronger baseline, we use Bayesian optimization through the Tree-structured Parzen Estimator (TPE), which is widely adopted for expensive black-box optimization. TPE models the objective distribution by separating past observations into relatively good and relatively bad regions and then selecting new candidates by maximizing expected improvement under this density-based representation. The implementation is based on Optuna [ 2 ] ver. 4.8.0, using its define-by-run framework and standard TPE sampler.

paragraphs.en: This section presents the experimental comparison between the LLM-driven agent, random search, TPE Bayesian optimization and the ( 1 + 1 ) (1+1) evolution strategy under the case-study assumptions introduced above. Figure 4 shows the convergence behavior of the methods as a function of the available evaluation budget, and Table 8 summarises the final values and the number of evaluations each method needs to come within 1% of the best design found in the study (3,525,522 EUR, i.e. at most 3,560,777 EUR) within their budget. The feasible rate is the fraction of evaluations whose dispatch satisfies the whole demand (for the agents, excluding the automatic baseline evaluation). The ablation without the domain-knowledge file is reported separately in Section 7.4 .

sents.en: Baseline statistics are computed over ten seeds of 300 evaluations, and agent statistics over ten runs of at most 50 simulations.

paragraphs.en: Random search attains a median final NPC of 4.053 MEUR after 300 evaluations, and only 19.8% of them satisfy the whole demand (feasible results). TPE improves the median to 3.596 MEUR, with a best seed at 3.568 MEUR and 70.1% of its evaluations feasible. The ( 1 + 1 ) (1+1) evolution strategy, which shares the agent’s acceptance rule, attains the best baseline results: a median of 3.557 MEUR, a best seed at 3.534 MEUR and 73.3% feasible evaluations, although one of its ten seeds remains trapped at 4.782 MEUR with a PV field of only 560 m 2 . No random-search or TPE seed reaches ( 1 + δ ) ​ NPC ⋆ (1+\delta)\,\mathrm{NPC}^{\star} in 300 evaluations; only the ( 1 + 1 ) (1+1) -ES enters this band, in five of its ten seeds, after a median of 192 evaluations and at most 246, while the other five seeds never reach it.

paragraphs.en: All ten Opus 5.5 runs end at the best design, six Sonnet 5.5 runs and only one Haiku 5.5 run. Moreover, all ten Haiku runs and all ten Opus runs reach the 1 % 1\% band, whereas two Sonnet runs never do, because they remain trapped with a larger heat pump. In terms of near-optimal designs Haiku is therefore, in these runs, more reliable than Sonnet (ten against eight runs in the band), although it reaches the exact optimum less often. Regarding the speed to reach the 1 % 1\% band, Opus, Sonnet and Haiku need, at most, 31, 30 and 45 evaluations, respectively. Compared with the only baseline that reaches the band, the ( 1 + 1 ) (1+1) -ES, the agent reaches the band more often (28 of 30 runs against 5 of 10 seeds) and, among the runs that reach it, needs between seven and eleven times fewer evaluations (median of 18 to 27.5 against 192).

paragraphs.en: The gap between the best agent design and the best TPE seed is about 43 kEUR over 25 years, and that to the best ( 1 + 1 ) (1+1) -ES seed about 8 kEUR; the gaps to the medians are about 71 kEUR (TPE) and 32 kEUR ( ( 1 + 1 ) (1+1) -ES). These differences are small compared with the uncertainty introduced by the modelling assumptions discussed in Section 5 . The result is not that the agent finds a materially better plant than a well-run Bayesian optimizer or local search, but that it reaches the best region of the design space with a few tens of simulations, in 28 of the 30 runs, whereas the best baseline reaches it in half of its seeds and only after about two hundred evaluations (median 192), while producing a motivation for each decision.
paragraphs.zh: 最佳智能体设计与最佳TPE种子之间的差距在25年内约为4.3万欧元，与最佳(1+1)-ES种子的差距约为8千欧元；与中位数的差距约为7.1万欧元（TPE）和3.2万欧元（(1+1)-ES）。 与第5节讨论的建模假设所引入的不确定性相比，这些差异很小。 结果并不是该智能体找到了比运行良好的贝叶斯优化器或局部搜索明显更好的工厂设计，而是它在30次运行中的28次里，仅用几十次仿真就到达了设计空间的最优区域，而最佳基线方法仅在一半的种子中到达该区域，且需要大约两百次评估（中位数为192），同时该智能体还为每个决策生成了动机说明。

paragraphs.en: Table 9 presents the best design found by each optimisation method. The designs are qualitatively consistent across methods. The best design, found by all ten Opus 5.5 runs, six Sonnet 5.5 runs and one Haiku 5.5 run, consists of a reversible heat pump of 700 kW th ; a PV field of 2,000 m 2 connected through an inverter of 360 or 400 kW (the two ratings give the same NPC) with efficiency 0.98; a battery of 100 kWh and 50 kW with efficiency 0.99 and a 50 kW inverter with efficiency 0.98; a solar-thermal field of 260 m 2 ; and a CHP unit of 10 kW el with efficiencies 0.32 (electrical) and 0.58 (thermal). No boiler and no wind turbine are installed.
paragraphs.zh: 表9给出了每种优化方法找到的最优设计。 各方法得到的设计在性质上是一致的。 最优设计由全部十次Opus 5.5运行、六次Sonnet 5.5运行和一次Haiku 5.5运行找到，其组成包括：一台700 kW th 的可逆热泵；一个2,000 m 2 的光伏阵列，通过一台360或400 kW（两种额定功率给出相同的NPC）的逆变器接入，效率为0.98；一个100 kWh、50 kW的电池，效率为0.99，并配有一台效率为0.98的50 kW逆变器；一个260 m 2 的太阳能集热场；以及一台10 kW el 的热电联产机组，其效率为0.32（电）和0.58（热）。 未安装锅炉和风力涡轮机。

paragraphs.en: Two aspects of the best design deserve comment. First, the PV area is at the upper bound of its admissible range, and so are the battery capacity and power; these bounds are effectively active, and a larger admissible range, or an explicit roof-area constraint, would change the result. The PV inverter has no cost in this scenario, and every size above about 340 kW gives the same NPC, so the optimum is degenerate in this variable: what matters is that the inverter can handle the PV peak at the maximum irradiance, 2,000 ​ m 2 × 0.18 × 937 ​ W / m 2 ≈ 337 2{,}000~\mathrm{m^{2}}\times 0.18\times 937~\mathrm{W/m^{2}}\approx 337 kW. Second, all conversion efficiencies are at their upper bounds, as expected from a cost model that does not link cost to efficiency directly. The battery is part of all the best designs, and it is valued only through self-consumption, since the tariff is flat and exported energy is paid 0.08 EUR/kWh against 0.30 EUR/kWh for purchased energy.
paragraphs.zh: 该最优设计中有两个方面值得评述。 首先，光伏面积处于其允许范围的上界，电池容量与功率也是如此；这些上界实际上是有效的约束，若允许范围更大，或显式加入屋顶面积约束，结果将随之改变。 在该场景下光伏逆变器没有成本，约 340 kW 以上的任何容量都给出相同的总净现值成本，因此该变量的最优解是退化的：关键在于逆变器能够承受最大辐照度下的光伏峰值功率，即 2,000​ m² × 0.18 × 937​ W/m² ≈ 337 2{,}000~\mathrm{m^{2}}\times 0.18\times 937~\mathrm{W/m^{2}}\approx 337 kW。 其次，所有转换效率都处于其上界，这对于一个未将成本与效率直接挂钩的成本模型而言是符合预期的。 电池出现在所有最优设计中，其价值仅通过自用体现，因为电价是平价电价，且外送电能仅按 0.08 欧元/千瓦时计价，而购电成本为 0.30 欧元/千瓦时。

paragraphs.en: The other agent runs end on close variants of this design. Five Haiku runs omit the CHP and use 270 m 2 of solar thermal (+425 EUR); the remaining near-optimal runs differ only in the solar-thermal area (250–255 m 2 ) or in the CHP size (30 kW el in one Sonnet run); the Haiku run that stopped early also keeps a 5 kW boiler (+11.7 kEUR), and the worst Haiku run has no CHP, 300 m 2 of solar thermal and a smaller battery (70 kWh, 30 kW; +18.2 kEUR). paragraphs.en: Overall, with all three models the LLM-driven agent matches, and in this case study marginally improves upon, the final solution quality of established baselines at a substantially smaller evaluation budget, while preserving a level of traceability that remains difficult to obtain from conventional black-box optimizers alone. The capability of the model affects mainly the reliability and the speed of the search: the smallest model is competitive at this budget but less precise in the final refinement, and a mid-sized model can occasionally lock itself into a suboptimal region.
paragraphs.zh: 总体而言，在全部三种模型下，由大语言模型驱动的智能体在评估预算大幅减少的情况下，达到了既有基线的最终解质量，且在本案例研究中还略有提升，同时保留了传统黑盒优化器难以提供的可追溯性水平。 模型的能力主要影响搜索的可靠性和速度：最小的模型在该预算下具有竞争力，但在最终精化阶段精度较低，而中等规模的模型有时会将自己锁定在次优区域。

paragraphs.en: Without the file, Opus 5.5 still finds NPC ⋆ \mathrm{NPC}^{\star} , and the median run ends on it; the feasible rate is essentially unchanged (90.0% against 89.0%). Eight runs end at the best design, the number of evaluations needed to enter the 1% band is similar to that of the complete configuration (median 19.5 against 18), and the maximum number of evaluations needed is 46 instead of 31 with the file (Figure 5 a). Without the file the first experiments are also less effective: after five simulations the median best NPC is 3.92 MEUR, against 3.77 MEUR with the file, and the two curves become similar only after about seven simulations. Also for Haiku 5.5 the differences are small (Figure 5 b). The final values are the same as with the file (best NPC ⋆ \mathrm{NPC}^{\star} , median 3,525,947 EUR), two runs end at the best design instead of one, nine of ten enter the 1% band after a median of 27 evaluations (27.5 with the file), and the two convergence curves are close from the first experiments.

paragraphs.en: The domain-knowledge file is therefore not needed to find the best design: both models reach NPC ⋆ \mathrm{NPC}^{\star} and the same median value without it, inferring from the simulator output, which prints the CAPEX and OPEX at every run, most of what the file states, including the absence of costs for efficiencies and inverters. The file appears, however, to reduce the variability between runs (Figure 5 ). For Opus 5.5, the interquartile range of the best NPC is narrower with the file in the first experiments and closes after about 30 simulations, whereas without the file it remains at about 120 kEUR until simulation 35. For Haiku 5.5 the effect is weaker and not uniform: the range is narrower with the file between the sixth and the tenth simulation and after the 35th, but wider between the 12th and the 20th. These results suggest a more predictable search, especially for Opus 5.5.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，寻找最优设计并不需要领域知识文件：两个模型在没有该文件的情况下同样达到了 NPC ⋆ \mathrm{NPC}^{\star} 和相同的中位数值，并且从模拟器输出（每次运行都会打印 CAPEX 和 OPEX）中可推断出该文件所述的大部分内容，包括对效率设备和逆变器不计成本这一点。 然而，该文件似乎能减少各次运行之间的变异（图 5）。 对于 Opus 5.5，在前几次实验中，使用该文件时最优 NPC 的四分位距更窄，并在约 30 次模拟后收敛为零；而不使用该文件时，四分位距在第 35 次模拟之前一直保持在约 120 千欧元。 对于 Haiku 5.5，这一影响较弱且并不一致：在第 6 次至第 10 次模拟之间以及第 35 次之后，使用该文件时四分位距更窄，但在第 12 次至第 20 次之间则更宽。 这些结果表明使用该文件能使搜索更具可预测性，对 Opus 5.5 而言尤为明显。

paragraphs.en: In the following we report how the sessions comply with the rules of Section 4.1.3 , and the reasoning error that explains the two Sonnet 5.5 runs that never come within 1% of the best design.
paragraphs.zh: 在下文中，我们报告各会话如何遵守第 4.1.3 节的规则，以及解释两次 Sonnet 5.5 运行始终未能接近最佳设计 1% 以内的推理错误。

paragraphs.en: No run reads or modifies the simulator, the cost parameters or the hooks, or writes the experiment counter or the state files; every simulation is launched through the hooks, and no run records an infeasible design as accepted. The rule of changing one to three logically related parameters per experiment is respected by all runs, if switching a technology on or off is counted as a single change: a technology that is switched on must also be given a size, and for PV and the battery an inverter, to be tested at all. Counted parameter by parameter, 32 of the 500 Opus experiments, 31 of the 500 Sonnet experiments and 16 of the 485 Haiku experiments change four or more parameters; all of them switch on a technology (CHP, battery, boiler, wind turbine or PV) together with its size, efficiency or inverter, in ten cases a boiler together with a change of the heat-pump size. Seven simulations (three by Opus, three by Sonnet and one by Haiku) are run on an unchanged configuration and are recognised and not recorded by the post-execution hook. One Opus run repeats a rejected configuration, against the rules, while one Opus run and two Haiku runs repeat four accepted configurations in total, which wastes budget but is not forbidden. In the ablation without insights.md (Section 7.4 ), no session reads the file, and a single experiment, in a Haiku 5.5 run, violates the rule, changing the battery capacity, power and inverter together with the heat-pump size.
paragraphs.zh: 没有任何运行读取或修改模拟器、成本参数或钩子，也没有运行写入实验计数器或状态文件；每次仿真都通过钩子启动，且没有运行将不可行的设计记录为已接受。 每次实验更改一到三个逻辑上相关联的参数这一规则被所有运行遵守，前提是将某项技术的开启或关闭算作单次更改：一项被开启的技术还必须同时给定容量，对于光伏和电池还须给定逆变器，才能进行测试。 逐参数统计，500 次 Opus 实验中有 32 次、500 次 Sonnet 实验中有 31 次、485 次 Haiku 实验中有 16 次更改了四个或更多参数；所有这些运行都同时开启一项技术（热电联产、电池、锅炉、风机或光伏）及其容量、效率或逆变器，其中十例是锅炉与热泵容量的更改同时进行。 有七次仿真（Opus 三次、Sonnet 三次、Haiku 一次）在未更改的配置上运行，并被执行后钩子识别且未予记录。 一次 Opus 违规运行重复了某个被拒绝的配置，而一次 Opus 运行和两次 Haiku 运行总共重复了四个已被接受的配置，这浪费了预算但并不被禁止。 在没有 insights.md 的消融实验（第 7.4 节）中，没有会话读取该文件，但一次 Haiku 5.5 运行中的一个实验违反了规则，同时更改了电池容量、功率和逆变器以及热泵容量。

paragraphs.en: In this case study the agent reaches designs of equal or better final quality than the baselines with far fewer simulations. With all three models the agent comes within 1% of the best design after a median of 18 to 27.5 simulations over the runs that reach it (all runs for Opus and Haiku, eight of ten for Sonnet), whereas the ( 1 + 1 ) (1+1) -ES does so in only five of ten seeds, after a median of 192 evaluations, and TPE and random search never do within 300 evaluations (Table 8 ). The ( 1 + 1 ) (1+1) -ES starts from the same configuration as the agent and uses the same acceptance rule and the same limit of one to three changes per move, where switching a technology on counts as one change and assigns all its parameters. It differs in how the move is chosen: the ES perturbs randomly chosen parameters independently, with random step sizes and random sizes for a technology switched on, whereas the agent chooses related parameters together, such as a PV field and its inverter, or a boiler and the heat-pump size. Since the acceptance rule is the same, the difference in the number of evaluations is due to the choice of moves. This is precisely where the agent differs from a black-box optimizer: it exploits information that the baselines cannot use, namely the cost breakdown returned by the simulator, the domain knowledge of insights.md and the general design knowledge of the model, and turns it into coordinated moves.
paragraphs.zh: 在本案例研究中，智能体以远少于基线方法的仿真次数，达到了相同或更优的最终设计质量。 对于全部三个模型，智能体在达到最佳设计的各次运行中（Opus 和 Haiku 为全部运行，Sonnet 为十次中的八次），中位数只需 18 至 27.5 次仿真即可进入最佳设计的 1% 范围之内；而 (1+1)-ES 只在十个种子中的五个做到这一点，且中位数需要 192 次评估，TPE 和随机搜索则在 300 次评估内从未做到（表 8）。 (1+1)-ES 与智能体从相同的配置出发，采用相同的接受规则以及每次移动一至三处修改的相同限制，其中开启一项技术算作一处修改，并会设定其所有参数。 两者的区别在于移动的选择方式：ES 以随机步长和随机大小独立地扰动随机选定的参数，对开启的技术也使用随机大小，而智能体则将相关参数作为一个整体来选择，例如光伏阵列及其逆变器，或锅炉与热泵的规模。 由于接受规则相同，评估次数上的差异源于移动方式的选择。 这正是智能体与黑盒优化器的区别所在：它利用了基线方法无法使用的信息，即仿真器返回的成本明细、insights.md 中的领域知识以及模型所具备的通用设计知识，并将其转化为协调一致的移动。

paragraphs.en: The approach reduces the number of simulator calls, not the total computation: every experiment also requires a call to the language model, which for cloud-served models has a cost. A run cost between 1.61 and 2.26 USD with Opus 5.5, between 0.99 and 1.75 USD with Sonnet 5.5 and between 0.63 and 1.28 USD with Haiku 5.5, and lasted between 11 and 17 minutes, except for two Sonnet sessions (37 minutes and 2.4 hours) in which the agent inserted unnecessary waits. In this case study one simulation takes about 7 s and a baseline seed of 300 evaluations about 35 minutes, so in monetary terms the agent is not cheaper than the baselines, although a run takes less wall-clock time (11–17 minutes) than a baseline seed (35 minutes) or than the about 22 minutes that the ( 1 + 1 ) (1+1) -ES needs, in its median successful seed, to enter the 1% band; its smaller number of simulations reduces the total cost only when a single simulation is considerably more expensive than a call to the model.

paragraphs.en: The results have the following limitations. They refer to a single case study, with one climate, one tariff structure and a single-objective NPC formulation. They are obtained with one family of models and one coding agent, whose versions are reported in Section 6 ; other models and agents were not tested. The agent receives in insights.md the cost structure of the technologies, from which it can infer, for instance, that efficiencies and inverter ratings carry no cost, information that the black-box baselines do not use; since the cost model does not depend on the efficiencies, their optimum lies at the upper bound. The ablation of Section 7.4 shows that this information is not needed to find the best design: without the file, Opus 5.5 infers from the simulator output, in which inverters carry no CAPEX and a change of efficiency leaves the CAPEX unchanged, that efficiencies and inverters are free, and reaches NPC ⋆ \mathrm{NPC}^{\star} in eight of ten runs, and Haiku 5.5 behaves as with the file. The file seems to reduce the variability between runs, especially for Opus 5.5. Finally, part of the agent’s behaviour may reflect design rules learned during training rather than reasoning on the observed results, and the present experiments cannot separate the two.
paragraphs.zh: 研究结果存在以下局限性。 它们基于单一案例研究，只涉及一种气候条件、一种电价结构和一个单目标的 NPC 优化公式。 它们是使用一个模型系列和一个编程智能体得到的，其版本已在第 6 节中报告；其他模型和智能体未经测试。 该智能体从 insights.md 中获得各技术的成本结构，由此可以推断出，例如效率和逆变器额定值不产生成本，而黑盒基线并未利用这一信息；由于成本模型不依赖于效率，其最优解位于上限处。 第 7.4 节的消融实验表明，寻找最优设计并不需要这些信息：在没有该文件的情况下，Opus 5.5 从模拟器输出（其中逆变器不产生 CAPEX，且效率改变不影响 CAPEX）推断出效率和逆变器是免费的，并在十次运行中的八次达到了 NPC ⋆ \mathrm{NPC}^{\star}，而 Haiku 5.5 的表现与有该文件时相同。 该文件似乎降低了运行之间的波动性，尤其是对 Opus 5.5 而言。 最后，智能体的部分行为可能反映的是训练期间学到的设计规则，而非基于观测结果的推理，而本实验无法将两者区分开。

paragraphs.en: This paper presented AutoEnergyDesign, a framework for automatic energy system design optimization driven by Large Language Models. The main contributions are an LLM-based optimization architecture organised around an explicit set of memories, a detailed techno-economic formulation of the design problem, a git-based state-management mechanism that never loses the best design found, and an empirical comparison against established baselines with three models of different capability.
paragraphs.zh: 本文提出了 AutoEnergyDesign，一个由大语言模型驱动的能源系统设计自动优化框架。 主要贡献包括：一个围绕显式记忆集合组织的基于大语言模型的优化架构、设计问题的详细技术经济建模、一种永不丢失已找到最优设计的基于 git 的状态管理机制，以及使用三个不同能力水平的模型与既有基线进行的实证比较。

paragraphs.en: Overall, the results indicate that LLM-driven optimization can reach competitive solution quality at a substantially reduced number of simulator evaluations while offering a level of traceability of the decisions that is difficult to obtain from conventional black-box methods alone. In the case study, the agents driven by Haiku 5.5, Sonnet 5.5 and Opus 5.5 all found the best design of the study, with an NPC of about 3.526 MEUR. This value is 1.20% below the best of ten TPE seeds and 0.23% below the best of ten ( 1 + 1 ) (1+1) -ES seeds of 300 evaluations, and was obtained with at most 50 simulations per run. The models differ in reliability and speed: Opus 5.5 reached the best design in all ten runs, coming within 1% of it after a median of 18 simulations; Sonnet 5.5 reached it in six runs, while two never came within 1% of it; Haiku 5.5 reached it exactly only once, but all its runs came within 1% of it, after a median of 27.5 simulations. Without the domain-knowledge file, Opus 5.5 still found the best design, in eight of ten runs: the file is not needed to reach it, but it seems to make the search more predictable, especially for Opus 5.5. For Haiku 5.5, whose limit is the final refinement of the design, removing the file makes practically no difference. Among the baselines, only the ( 1 + 1 ) (1+1) evolution strategy, which shares the agent’s acceptance rule, comes within 1% of the best design, in five of ten seeds and after a median of 192 evaluations, which suggests that the advantage comes from the moves chosen by the model rather than from the acceptance rule: the agent exploits information on the problem that a black-box optimizer cannot use. The reasoning notes make every decision auditable and, in this sense, AutoEnergyDesign should be considered not as a replacement for existing optimizers, but as a complementary paradigm for engineering design problems in which reasoning traces, domain knowledge, and iterative experimentation all play a central role.
